description: On January 31st, lawyers representing Bill and Hillary Clinton reached out to the House Oversight Committee agreeing to testify, but requesting various accommodations. This follows a five-month back-and-forth negotiation to get the Clintons in front of the Oversight Committee to testify.
headline: US House Oversight Committee Majority Publicly Rejects Clinton's Offer to Testify

info.description: At 18:27 EST, a spokesperson for Former President Bill Clinton that Bill and Hillary Clinton will testify before the House Oversight Committee.
info.note: Angel Ureña, spokesman for Former President Bill Clinton, posted a status on X indicating that Bill and Hillary Clinton will be testifying before the House Oversight Committee, and are "look[ing] forward to setting a precedent that applies to everyone." This is not a dramatic departure from previous statements.
